title.narrative: Capacity Strengthening of RECOWA on Advocacy for Ecological Conversion, Social and Economic Justice

description.narrative: Based on the Resolutions of the 4th Plenary Assembly of RECOWA, a three years action plan (2022-2025) was developed to bring transformative change in systems and structures that limit ecological, social and economic justice to the people in the region. To enable RECOWA achieve part of this action plan, this project aims to strengthen the capacity of RECOWA to bring about the ecological, social and economic justice that is needed for men, women and children in the region. With the new knowledge and practical methods of carrying out advocacy, the National Directors for Justice, Peace and Development will cascade the training to various structures within each national Bishops conference and they will spearhead interventions to better preserve the environment and improve the situation of the people, communities and nations in the most effective, sensitive and efficient way.
